features.feature_value: Removed posts when they were solely opinion-based; assessed whether content was fact-based vs interpretation/opinion.
features.evidence_span: I tried to evaluate whether the posts were based in fact ... or merely opinion. I removed them if they were solely opinion-based.
features.rationale: The participant explicitly states evaluating factual basis vs mere opinion and using that to decide removal.

features.feature_value: Deleted content that was inappropriate, included cuss words, or hate.
features.evidence_span: If it was inappropriate,used cuss words and hate I deleted both
features.rationale: The participant uses explicit language/toxicity markers (cuss words, hate) as the deletion criterion.

features.feature_value: Rejected posts that called other posters names or used harsh language; did not restrict purely political responses.
features.evidence_span: rejected posts calling other posters names  or using arsh language towards other posters. I did not limit purely political responses
features.rationale: The reflection centers on interpersonal abuse (name-calling/harsh language) as the basis for rejection.

features.feature_value: Decided based on whether posts expressed opinion versus hate speech.
features.evidence_span: I made the decision based on the extent to which the posts seemed to express an opinion vs hate speech.
features.rationale: The participant directly describes the opinion/hate-speech distinction as the decision rule.

features.feature_value: Removed posts expected to be inflammatory or yield nothing gained; expressed frustration about constant fighting.
